summary: Implemented the Tabs feature (not committed, nothing run). Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py with Tab, TabsRenderable, and Tabs (state, keys, range_clicked action, animated bar via watch__active_tab_name); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (single Text output, click spans last, zero-width early path without clicks); Opacity now merges the blended color into the existing style, preserving meta and other attributes; layout resolver Edge docstring only, since min_size/fraction/size defaults already existed. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, and tests: new cases in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and test_opacity.py, plus tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Choices: bar index uses displayed-tab position (per acceptance criterion 11) rather than find_tab_by_name's full-list index; letter search only applies to single-character keys; empty labels omit the label edge. Unverified: tests were not run, and rich Style meta-merge and Text span behavior are assumed from rich 11.2.
